recognize_zh: A 圖淋巴結中上方殘存小淋巴球濾泡，下方副皮質區則被中到大型、染色質開放、核仁明顯的母細胞成片取代，並夾雜帶紅色顆粒的未成熟嗜伊紅球；B 圖 MPO 與 C 圖 CD34 強陽性，確認為髓性肉瘤。
features: Panel A (H&E): sheet of medium to large blasts with irregular vesicular nuclei, open chromatin, distinct nucleoli and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Residual follicle of small dark lymphocytes (upper field) sharply demarcated from the interfollicular/paracortical blast infiltrate
Scattered immature eosinophils with bright red granules and apoptotic bodies among the blasts
Panel B: diffuse strong granular cytoplasmic MPO positivity in the blasts
Panel C: diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic CD34 positivity in the blasts, with CD34+ endothelium in a vessel wall
describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows effacement of the paracortex by a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large blasts with irregular vesicular nuclei, open chromatin, distinct nucleoli and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, sparing a residual lymphoid follicle. Scattered immature eosinophils and apoptotic bodies are admixed. By immunohistochemistry the blasts are diffusely positive for myeloperoxidase and CD34. Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma (extramedullary myeloid tumor) involving lymph node; bone marrow evaluation and molecular studies (including NPM1) are recommended.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5 positive and MPO/CD34 negative, and lack admixed immature eosinophils.
Lymphoblasts have finer chromatin, scant cytoplasm and are TdT+ with CD3 or CD19/PAX5 and MPO negative.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma or anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show CD30+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg or hallmark cells within a mixed background, not MPO+ CD34+ monotonous blast sheets.
BPDCN is CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+ and MPO negative, typically presenting in skin.
